evals.prompt: Use normal engineering judgment for a task that should naturally activate shape.
evals.expected_output: The shape workflow is selected and follows its contract.

evals.prompt: Use the shape skill for this task.
evals.expected_output: The shape workflow is followed without unrelated ceremony.

evals.prompt: Fix a one-character typo in a README heading and do nothing else.
evals.expected_output: The shape skill should not be unnecessarily activated unless it is the direct owner of the request.

evals.prompt: Demonstrate the core decision procedure of shape while preserving existing project decisions.
evals.expected_output: Output follows the shape workflow and respects decision lock/provider neutrality.

evals.prompt: Use shape in a repository with unrelated uncommitted user changes.
evals.expected_output: The unrelated changes are preserved and the workflow does not reset or overwrite them.

evals.prompt: I want a phone-first save-for-later app where I can save links, browse them later, and keep using the app when I have no internet. Help shape the product; do not choose technology yet.
evals.expected_output: Shape does not silently turn 'keep using the app offline' into offline create/edit. It asks a focused product decision or records offline-write semantics as open, while preserving clearly stated offline browsing goals.

evals.prompt: Shape this project's product direction using the existing workspace context. The coding harness also has unrelated global memory files.
evals.expected_output: Workspace-local durable artifacts are treated as project authority; unrelated harness/global memory is not consulted or promoted into project truth unless the user explicitly requests reuse.

evals.prompt: The product is phone-first and should remain useful during connectivity loss. Shape the direction without choosing framework, storage, backend, or provider.
evals.expected_output: Shape surfaces mobile/local-first as material concerns but does not choose Flutter, React Native, SQLite, Firebase, cloud, or sync architecture.

evals.prompt: The current sync product artifact has separate open decisions for collection actions, synchronized field scope, conflict resolution, deletion behavior, account linking, and sign-out. The user answers only: 'Support add, edit, and remove, and eventually sync all three actions. Do not infer the other behaviors.' Record that decision and continue shaping.
evals.expected_output: Shape records add/edit/remove as the decided synchronized action surface, but keeps synchronized field scope, conflict resolution, deletion/restore semantics, account linking, and sign-out explicitly open. It must not delete or silently narrow those neighboring product questions unless the answer logically entails them.

evals.prompt: Continue shaping a feature with several unresolved product decisions. Ask only the single highest-impact human decision currently blocking executable planning.
evals.expected_output: Shape asks one focused product decision and does not silently answer or remove the remaining decision frontier.

evals.prompt: I have an idea for a household inventory product, but I am still deciding what the product should be. Use Proofcraft discover mode. Do not create files or code yet; ask me the single most important product question.
evals.expected_output: Shape enters opt-in discover mode, stays conversational, creates no durable artifact or code, and asks one material product question rather than choosing technology or producing a plan.

evals.prompt: Create a small CLI that renames FLAC files from embedded metadata. It is local-only, must preview changes before apply, and the requirements are already decided.
evals.expected_output: Discover is not activated merely because this is greenfield work. The request may proceed through normal shaping/planning/implementation with only necessary clarification.

evals.prompt: Use discover for a product idea whose core user and value are still uncertain. Keep hypotheses separate from decisions, challenge assumptions, and stop when you can classify readiness.
evals.expected_output: The conversation distinguishes DECIDED, HYPOTHESIS, OPEN, and DEFERRED, avoids implementation choices, and ends at an appropriate READY_TO_SHAPE, NEEDS_MORE_DISCOVERY, NEEDS_RESEARCH, or PARK checkpoint without inventing artifacts.

evals.prompt: Use discover for this new product. The repository contains the local Proofcraft skills and a README. The coding harness also has unrelated global/personal memory from other projects. I did not ask you to reuse that memory.
evals.expected_output: Discover inspects only the current workspace and explicitly supplied context. It does not search or rely on global/personal harness memory unless the user requests reuse or the workspace points there.

evals.prompt: Use Proofcraft discover in batch mode. We have already settled the product's core user, value, inventory semantics, and collaboration model. Give me the remaining material product questions in one pass so I can answer them together. Do not create files or ask implementation questions.
evals.expected_output: Discover honors explicit batch questioning, does not repeat settled decisions, presents a bounded remaining material frontier, distinguishes blocking/deferred/conditional questions when useful, avoids implementation choices, and creates no durable artifact.

evals.prompt: Use Proofcraft shape in batch mode for this feature. Several independent behavior decisions remain and I want to answer them in one response.
evals.expected_output: Shape presents one bounded batch of material unresolved behavior decisions, excludes project-discoverable facts and implementation trivia, preserves dependencies as conditional, and does not silently resolve unanswered decisions.

evals.prompt: Continue shaping this product using the default questioning strategy. Early decisions were strongly dependent, but the major direction is now stable and I want less back-and-forth.
evals.expected_output: Shape uses adaptive pacing: it may start or remain single while dependencies are high, then switches to a bounded batch once the remaining material frontier is mostly independent, without broadening scope or inventing questions.

evals.prompt: Shape a greenfield household application whose product behavior is now settled, but no platform, data authority, runtime boundaries, storage architecture, or other durable system decisions have been made yet.
evals.expected_output: Shape may complete the product/spec artifacts, but its next-workflow guidance routes to architect rather than directly to plan because consequential architecture remains undecided. It must not choose the architecture itself.

evals.prompt: Use Proofcraft shape in batch interactive mode. Several independent product decisions remain. If the harness supports structured questions, let me answer them interactively.
evals.expected_output: Shape uses batch strategy and interactive presentation when supported, without changing or expanding the material decision frontier.

evals.prompt: Use Proofcraft shape in batch plain mode because I need to copy the questions elsewhere.
evals.expected_output: Shape uses batch strategy but renders the bounded material question set as ordinary copyable text instead of requiring interactive controls.
